findings.en_sentence: The species Palaeotriakis subserratus serves as the type species, meaning it is the specific fossil used to define the entire genus.
findings.es_sentence: La especie Palaeotriakis subserratus sirve como especie tipo, lo que significa que es el fósil específico utilizado para definir todo el género.
findings.problem: The type species is a species that anchors the genus name, not a specific fossil; the fossil that fixes a name is the holotype.
findings.correct: Palaeotriakis subserratus is the type species, the species to which the genus name is permanently tied.

findings.en_sentence: The genus includes two species that were originally classified as species of Paratriakis.
findings.es_sentence: El género incluye dos especies que fueron clasificadas originalmente como especies de Paratriakis.
findings.problem: Paratriakis was named by Herman in 1977, so a species described by Davis in 1887 cannot have been described in Paratriakis from the start. The enwiki sentence is loose: both species were in Paratriakis before 2013, not originally.
findings.correct: Both species had been placed in Paratriakis before they were moved to Palaeotriakis in 2013.

findings.en_sentence: Later studies suggest that Palaeotriakis curtirostris actually belongs to the genus Paratriakis rather than Palaeotriakis.
findings.es_sentence: Estudios posteriores sugieren que el Palaeotriakis curtirostris pertenece en realidad al género Paratriakis en lugar de al género Palaeotriakis.
findings.problem: This clashes with the flat claim that the genus includes two species. 'actually belongs' also overstates the source, which only says later studies (Adolfssen & Ward 2014; Adolfssen et al. 2017) keep it in Paratriakis.
findings.correct: Some later studies keep P. curtirostris in Paratriakis, so it is uncertain whether it belongs in Palaeotriakis; the classification sentence should hedge 'two species'.

findings.en_sentence: This animal lived between 85.7 and 72.2 million years ago, spanning the Santonian to the Campanian stages.
findings.es_sentence: Este animal vivió entre hace 85,7 y 72,2 millones de años, abarcando los pisos santoniense y campaniense.
findings.problem: The PBDB range is stated as fact, but the cited enwiki revision's taxobox gives the range as Turonian. The sources disagree and the page does not say so.
findings.correct: Say that fossil records date it to the Santonian–Campanian (PBDB), noting that other sources give an earlier, Turonian age.

findings.en_sentence: This animal lived between 85.7 and 72.2 million years ago, spanning the Santonian to the Campanian stages.
findings.es_sentence: Este animal vivió entre hace 85,7 y 72,2 millones de años, abarcando los pisos santoniense y campaniense.
findings.problem: 'entre hace' is the wrong word order in Spanish.
findings.correct: Este animal vivió hace entre 85,7 y 72,2 millones de años, del Santoniense al Campaniense.

findings.en_sentence: Scientists have found only six recorded fossil occurrences of this ancient shark.
findings.es_sentence: Los científicos han encontrado solo seis registros fósiles de este antiguo tiburón.
findings.problem: '6' is the number of occurrence records in PBDB, not a count of every find scientists have made.
findings.correct: The Paleobiology Database lists six fossil occurrences of this shark.
